step1.helpCozeStatic: Coze Config Gray-Box Scanning Task: upload app/workflow export YAML only—no live chat/API calls. Detection rules and each attack command’s expected_success / non_vulnerability (via LLM when enabled) are evaluated against the YAML text. Structure parsing is optimized for typical app-export YAML.
step1.helpCozeAudit: Coze Config Gray-Box & API Black-Box Scanning Task: upload export YAML for static analysis (gray-box), and run attack commands against your Coze bot with optional rule- and LLM-based checks on responses (API black-box) when the run produces them.
step1.helpCozeApi: Coze API Security Scanning Task: black-box security testing against your Coze bot API—automated attack rounds with an LLM judge comparing expected vs actual responses.
step1.helpFastgptStatic: FastGPT Config Gray-Box Scanning Task: upload workflow/app export JSON only—no live chat/API calls when configured for static-only. Detection and attack-command checks run against the export text where applicable.
step1.helpFastgptAudit: FastGPT Config Gray-Box & API Black-Box Scanning Task: upload export JSON for static analysis (gray-box), and run attack commands against your FastGPT app with optional rule- and LLM-based checks on responses (API black-box) when the run produces them.
step1.helpFastgptApi: FastGPT API Security Scanning Task: black-box security testing against your FastGPT OpenAI-compatible API—automated attack rounds with an LLM judge comparing expected vs actual responses.
step1.helpN8nStatic: N8N Config Gray-Box Scanning Task: upload workflow export JSON only—no live runtime calls when configured for static-only. Detection and attack-command checks run against the export text where applicable.
step1.helpN8nAudit: N8N Config Gray-Box & API Black-Box Scanning Task: upload workflow export JSON for static analysis (gray-box), and run attack commands against your N8N workflow endpoint with optional rule- and LLM-based checks on responses (API black-box) when the run produces them.
step1.helpN8nApi: N8N API Security Scanning Task: black-box security testing against your N8N workflow/API endpoint—automated attack rounds with an LLM judge comparing expected vs actual responses.
step1.helpDifyStatic: Dify Config Gray-Box Scanning Task: upload Dify app export YAML only—no live chat/API calls. Detection rules and each attack command’s expected_success / non_vulnerability (via LLM when enabled) are evaluated against the YAML text.
step1.helpDifyAudit: Dify Config Gray-Box & API Black-Box Scanning Task: upload Dify app export YAML for static analysis (gray-box), and run attack commands against your target with optional rule- and LLM-based checks on responses (API black-box) when the run produces them.
step1.helpDifyApi: Dify API Security Scanning Task: black-box security testing against your Dify application API—automated attack rounds with an LLM judge comparing expected vs actual responses.

developerApi.title: Developer API
developerApi.subtitle: For external scripts: Python + a zhian.* key to one-click start Dialogue Security / Output Compliance (quick-start → poll → findings).
developerApi.keysDescription: Keys are shown in full only once at creation or rotation. Assign module scopes when creating a key.
developerApi.migrationsRequiredBody: The external_api_keys table is missing. From the project root run: npm run db:migrate — then refresh this page.
developerApi.noAccessBody: You need the task:manage permission to create and manage API keys.
developerApi.docsDescription: Third-party Python for product assessments. Prefer POST /external/assessments/quick-start (server picks libraries like the UI wizards). Create keys here; call with Bearer zhian.*.
developerApi.overviewIntro: Responses use { success, data, error }. Missing scopes return 403. The script uses quick-start so you need not hand-build libIds / runConfig (same as UI wizards).
developerApi.flowBody:
1) Ledger agent has API runtime configured; compliance also needs an enabled LLM under Settings → Models
2) Get assetId (GET .../assets/agents)
3) POST /external/assessments/quick-start
   · body: { kind: "dialogue"|"compliance", assetId, start: true }
   · Server recommends libraries and fills runtime (optional libraryIds override)
4) Poll GET .../tasks/:id until completed / blocked / canceled
5) GET .../tasks/:id/findings and save JSON
Note: raw POST .../tasks needs full wizard fields — prefer quick-start
developerApi.overviewScopes: Keys need at least assessments:read/write and reports:read/write; use assets:read to list assets.
developerApi.scopesHint: Select at least one. Use read-only for CI pull jobs.
developerApi.keysApiIntro: These routes require a normal user session token (same as the web app).
developerApi.webhookIntro: When creating an attack task (legacy) with callbackUrl, terminal status triggers a POST webhook.
developerApi.webhookBody:
Request headers:
  Content-Type: application/json
  X-Webhook-Timestamp: <ms>
  X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>

HMAC key: webhookVerificationSecret from create-task response.
Sign: timestamp + "." + raw JSON body with HMAC-SHA256.

Body example:
  { "event": "task.finished", "taskId": "...", "status": "completed" }

Retries use backoff; most 4xx are not retried.
developerApi.dialogCreateDescription: The full key is shown only once after creation.
developerApi.secretHintDefault: This is the only time the full key is shown. Copy it to a safe place.
developerApi.secretHintRotate: The previous key has been revoked. Save the new key now.
developerApi.revokeDescription: Integrations using this key will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
developerApi.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the record. The key is already invalid; this only clears it from your organization’s key list.
developerApi.rotateDescription: The current key will be revoked and a new key will be issued. Save the new key when it appears.
developerApi.pythonPrerequisite: Replace API_KEY, ASSET_ID, LIB_IDS; set TASK_KIND to dialogue or compliance. Requires: pip install requests
developerApi.pythonTabIntro: End-to-end sample for both sidebar assessment types. Switch create payload via TASK_KIND.
developerApi.opGroupHint: Grouped by operation; Assessments split Dialogue Security vs Output Compliance (create / read / execute).
developerApi.opEmpty: No APIs in this category yet
developerApi.attackTasksCompatNote: Legacy attack-task routes kept for compatibility. Prefer Assessments + Reports for new integrations.
